discrepancies.claim: All paths are POSIX-style and absolute (starting with /) for the instance methods.
discrepancies.behavior: While the instance is mounted, its own methods resolve paths under the mount point: v.readFileSync('/a') throws ENOENT, v.readFileSync(`${mountPoint}/a`) works. Unprefixed paths work again after unmount(). Undocumented. Seen on v26.13.0 and v28.0.0-pre.

discrepancies.claim: RealFSProvider: symbolic links resolving outside the root are rejected.
discrepancies.behavior: readFileSync('/link') follows a symlink (absolute or relative target) that points outside the root, directly and through the mount. Only realpathSync rejects it with EACCES. Seen on v26.13.0 and v28.0.0-pre.

discrepancies.claim: vfs.md says .node addons in a mounted VFS can be require()d. The SEA doc says addons cannot be loaded directly from the VFS.
discrepancies.behavior: Not verified for addons. ffi.dlopen() from a mounted VFS does work (v26.13.0, main).
True on main. v26.13.0 builds such a config without error. The page has no YAML changes entry for this.
